question_text: Find the monic polynomial equation of degree 3 whose roots are 2, 3 and 6.

mark_split.label: Write the equation as a product of factors

recall_prompt: Say what monic means and how you build the equation from its roots.
insider_note: The coefficients are −S₁, +S₂, −S₃ = −11, 36, −36; expanding the factors and the root relations must give the same three numbers.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write the factors
steps.margin_note: First mark. Monic means the leading coefficient is 1, so the equation is just the product of (x − root) for each root.
lines: Monic means the leading coefficient is 1.

recall.must_convey: That a monic equation with roots 2, 3, 6 is (x − 2)(x − 3)(x − 6) = 0.
accept: monic means leading coefficient one so the equation is x minus two times x minus three times x minus six equals zero
write the product of x minus each root
the factors are x minus two, x minus three and x minus six
monic ante leading coefficient one, x minus two into x minus three into x minus six

steps.why: A polynomial with roots 2, 3, 6 must contain (x − 2), (x − 3) and (x − 6) as factors; 'monic' fixes the overall constant at 1, so this product IS the polynomial. (The relations S₁ = 11, S₂ = 36, S₃ = 36 give the same coefficients.)
common_mistakes: Not saying what monic means, which is part of the question.

steps.label: Expand
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Multiply two brackets first, then the third. The coefficients are −S₁, +S₂, −S₃: 11, 36, 36.

recall.must_convey: That expanding the product gives x³ − 11x² + 36x − 36 = 0.
accept: expand and the equation is x cube minus eleven x square plus thirty six x minus thirty six
multiply out to x cubed minus eleven x squared plus thirty six x minus thirty six equals zero
the answer is x cube minus eleven x square plus thirty six x minus thirty six
expand chesthe x cube minus eleven x square plus thirty six x minus thirty six
multiply the first two brackets then the third

steps.why: The coefficients that come out are −(sum of roots), +(sum of pairwise products), −(product): 11, 36, 36. Expanding and the relations must agree — that is the check.
common_mistakes: A slip collecting like terms: −9x² − 2x² = −11x² and 18x + 18x = 36x.
